# Report fixture

Copied verbatim from `results/smoke_l4_20261111/` on `main` at
`2678c63726a85b656b38c67e1b461a3f88ee4c9c`.
Only the small limits, pass-floor, sweep raw CSV, FFT per-kernel Markdown,
config-total and copy-calibration files are retained. No measured values are
edited. This is the owner's L4 smoke run, not official A100 performance data.

The original compact results omit `env.txt`, `ncu/index.csv` and the ncu version
and command captures. The golden report must preserve these missing metadata
fields as `n/a`. Old per-kernel tables lack the newer mixed-HBM/L2 and residency
columns; the generator can calculate them from the retained byte counts,
durations, dimensions and measured limits without inventing counter values.

Tests that change records in temporary directories are arithmetic/schema
fixtures only, never new GPU measurements. `golden.md` is generated by the
reporter from this fixture.

`synthetic_fft2_variants/` is a separate CPU-only schema/arithmetic fixture,
not a GPU run or performance evidence. Every numeric constant in that directory
is synthetic. It contains the canonical auto fft2 label and an explicit
out-of-place label in sweep, ncu index, totals and per-kernel CSVs. Input labels
are deliberately stored in reverse order. The two labels reuse kernel IDs and
have different timings and traffic totals to catch accidental joins by family.
`synthetic_fft2_variants.md` is the generated golden report with a comparison
against the same synthetic fixture. The original measured `golden.md` stays
unchanged.
